mapper.select:
SELECT cp.id 'project.id', cp.`name` 'project.name', cp.short_name 'project.shortName', cp.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', pm.id 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pa.id 'area.id', pa.`name` 'area.name', line.id 'productionLine.id', line.`name` 'productionLine.name', ta.serial_number, ta.specification, ta.material, ta.net_weight, ta.gross_weight, a.create_time completeTime, ap.specification auxiliarySpecification, ap.material auxiliaryMaterial, a.quantity auxiliaryQuantity, sac.type auxiliaryTypeName, a.price, a.wages FROM ( SELECT a.project_id, a.monomer_id, a.area_id, a.artifact_id, a.auxiliary_part_id, SUM( a.quantity ) quantity, a.price, sum( a.wages ) wages, DATE_FORMAT( c.create_time, '%Y/%m/%d' ) create_time, c.production_line_id FROM `mes_building_tech_artifact_auxiliary_price` a LEFT JOIN mes_building_complete c ON c.id = a.complete_id WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = 0
AND a.project_id = #{projectId}
AND c.task_type_enum = 2
AND DATE_FORMAT( c.create_time, '%Y/%m/%d' )>= DATE_FORMAT( #{startDate}, '%Y/%m/%d' )
AND DATE_FORMAT( c.create_time, '%Y/%m/%d' )<= DATE_FORMAT( #{endDate}, '%Y/%m/%d' )
GROUP BY a.project_id, a.monomer_id, a.area_id, a.price, a.quantity, create_time, c.production_line_id, a.artifact_id, a.auxiliary_part_id ) a LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = a.artifact_id LEFT JOIN tech_auxiliary_part ap ON ap.id = a.auxiliary_part_id LEFT JOIN sys_auxiliary_classification sac ON sac.id = ap.auxiliary_class_id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = a.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = a.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa ON pa.id = a.area_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line line ON line.id = a.production_line_id
AND sac.type = #{auxiliaryTypeEnum}
